reviews.text: I couldn’t be more grateful for the incredible work Jon, of Follow the Leader Dog Training, has done with my rescue, Elizabeth (aka Betty)! As a Northern dog mix with a free-roaming background, being on a leash and reacting to other dogs was a major challenge. Coming and going from my building and going on walks was incredibly stressful. I hired Jon for walk & train support shortly after adopting her. He approached Betty with so much care and a deep understanding of reactive dogs. He helped her build confidence while giving me practical tools to support her progress during an initial wave of recall and engagement training. After building that foundation over the past year, I hired Jon for a second wave of walk & train focused on desensitizing Betty to approaching other dogs on a loose leash. The progress she has made is remarkable and truly transformative. While Betty still has her signature spunk, she is learning to feel much calmer and more settled on walks. I cannot recommend Jon highly enough... 5 stars isn't enough!

Jon’s approach to dog training really owner training, has helped us work with our little guy’s behaviour.  Jon’s experience was reassuring and he provided us with the tools which we can use training our guy Farley, each day.  Thanks Jon. ““Yes”, then treat.”
Jon is a wonderful trainer that cares deeply about dogs and is very knowledgeable. His classes are very accessible and hands on. I highly recommend his services.

I first went to Follow The Leader classes in 2011 with our Golden Retriever at the time & I was just back in April 2026 with another ! Gracie (the studious pupil below :) and I did the Puppy Pupils class and it was so much fun each week. Jon teaches with such humour and positivity. He normalizes the frustrations of puppyhood by having them seen through a positive (& realistic) lens & also from the dogs point of view. The dogs respond to him instantly (& not just because of his great treats :), and this modelled what to do to the rest of us.  Each week's lessons were a fantastic review for me re- teaching Gracie & she loved going. Gracie was leading me right to the Gym in the church basement by the 3rd week, and the growth in her comfort level and learning was incredible to see week to week. Everyone we come across cannot believe how she responds to verbal and non-verbal cues at 14 weeks old (sit, down, stay, nice leash walking, leave it + lots more ), and we are utilizing all we've learned daily with her in being out and about.
We will be back for the 'Doggy Basics'  class and thank you Jon for such a wonderful way to start off with our 3rd Golden Retriever ! Would so highly recommend Follow The Leader to anyone !!
P.S. Click on the picture to see Gracie listening attentively :)

The 6 week puppy class was fun and John made it easy for the dog (and the owner) to feel like they were making progress each week. Wonderful for socializing the puppy before they can be with other dogs.

I am so glad we chose Follow The Leader.  Jon is so kind, knowledgeable and encouraging.  He makes learning fun (for both pup and parent) and he truly invests his energy to ensure the pups succeed.  He is caring and respectful to the dogs and breaks things down in steps to keep them motivated and feeling good about themselves.  Whether it's a brand new pup or a dog needing to brush up on skills, I would definitely recommend FTL!
Jon is the best! The lessons were fun and invaluable! The interaction with other puppies is amazing.

I found the class very helpful. I have done classes in the past with my other dogs and I appreciated the encouragement to be disciplined with training. I found the notes helpful. Charlie absolutely loved the class and forgot all his training about walking on the leash and pulled vigorously to get the the class to my chagrin.

I have been to puppy classes with 4 differerent dogs over the years and experienced many different styles of teaching and training.  This class was by far the most enjoyable experience and the most productive one for my pup Rocky in terms of what he learned.  The classes  were a great size and the facility had a great set up.    It even helped Rocky learn to go down the stairs because he was so excited for class! The use of  training demonstrations with the puppy participants at each session were really  helpful to see exactly how to execute each lesson.  We also had lots of personal time with Jon who was able to get around to everyone in the class and make sure that we were using  the proper technique and help us with individual concerns.  I also liked how he used the free play time as another learning opportunity  to teach our pups how to listen even when they are very engaged and distracted.  We also received a very helpful booklet for at home practice and Jon was terrific about answering emails with specific problems that came up at home.  My favourite part of the class was really Jon's teaching style as he has such a light humorous approach, but he also is so attuned to specific situations and understands each dog so quickly as though they were his own.   Even by email I got such great suggestions.  I have found Jon to be so helpful that I am having him help me for specific one on one training needs for Rocky as he has some specific issues that went beyond the classroom setting that Jon has already started to help me with!  He always seems to know exactly what to do right away and it works! If I could give 10 stars I would do it because this class is the best!

Puppy Pupils with Jon was a great start for our puppy! The playtime was really helpful for understanding how to do great intros, and the his training methods and explanations were great. The structure and pace each week was super manageable and helped us focus on getting those right, plus the guide helped us kind of go at our own pace as we were practicing throughout the week. Highly recommend!
